reason: My order book is full for months and my office help answers the phone, so a missed call costs me next to nothing. Paying 990 euros plus 149 a month to collect more enquiries I can't take on makes no sense.
objection: 149 euros a month is a lot for an SMS, and I don't need more enquiries. I need fewer interruptions. On top of that it's a brand-new company with no customers.
would_change_my_mind: If it sorted and turned down the enquiries for me, filtering out small jobs and tyre-kickers so my office spent less time on the phone, and it came from a company with other trade businesses already using it, at a much lower monthly price.
